example: Yesterday I cooked dinner for my family.
example_zh: 昨天我煮晚餐給家人吃。

example: I saw her at the market a few days ago.
example_zh: 我幾天前在市場看到她。
tip_zh: 中文「幾天前」，英文 ago 要放在最後

example: At first, I didn't like coffee.
example_zh: 一開始我不喜歡咖啡。
tip_zh: first 結尾的 st 要發出來，不要只說 firs

example: After that, we went home.
example_zh: 之後我們就回家了。

example: Suddenly, it started to rain.
example_zh: 突然開始下雨了。
tip_zh: 重音在第一音節 SUD，後面輕輕帶過

example: Finally, the bus came.
example_zh: 公車終於來了。

example: What happened to your phone?
example_zh: 你的手機怎麼了？

example: It rained, so I stayed home.
example_zh: 下雨了，所以我待在家。
tip_zh: stayed 的 d 要輕輕發出，別省略

example: We watched a movie last night.
example_zh: 我們昨晚看了一部電影。

example: I visited my aunt in Tainan.
example_zh: 我去台南看我阿姨。
tip_zh: t 結尾加 -ed 要多一個音節 /ɪd/

example: We went to the night market.
example_zh: 我們去了夜市。
tip_zh: go 是不規則動詞，不能說 goed

english: What did you do last weekend?
example: What did you do last weekend? Anything fun?
example_zh: 你上週末做了什麼？有好玩的嗎？
tip_zh: did you 常連成 didja，聽起來像 di-ja

example: Guess what? I got a new job!
example_zh: 你猜怎麼了？我找到新工作了！

chinese: 你一定不敢相信發生了什麼事。
example: You won't believe what happened at work today!
example_zh: 你一定不敢相信今天公司發生了什麼事！
tip_zh: won't 嘴巴要圓，跟 want 不一樣

example: And then what happened? Did you find it?
example_zh: 然後呢？你有找到嗎？

example: That's when I realized my wallet was gone.
example_zh: 就在那時我才發現錢包不見了。
tip_zh: realized 結尾唸 /zd/，喉嚨要震動

example: When I was a kid, I lived in Pingtung.
example_zh: 我小時候住在屏東。
tip_zh: 說小時候要用過去式 was，不是 am

example: We went to Kenting. It was so much fun!
example_zh: 我們去了墾丁，真的超好玩！

example: Thanks for inviting me. I had a great time!
example_zh: 謝謝你邀請我，我玩得很開心！
tip_zh: had a 連起來唸成 ha-da

example: Long story short, we missed the last train.
example_zh: 長話短說，我們錯過了末班車。
